source.title: Heapability, Interactive Particle Systems, Partial Orders: Results and Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL. Shell fetching failed with network_or_dns_failure: curl could not resolve host zbmath.org. Local resolver metadata from the project CSV identified the same work as DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-41114-9_2, HAL hal-01633954, DBLP conf/dcfs/IstrateB16, titled Heapability, Interactive Particle Systems, Partial Orders: Results and Open Problems.

Bounded recovery searched the exact title, exact DOI, zbMATH identifier, HAL identifier, and title plus PDF. The Springer proceedings page exposed only bibliographic table-of-contents metadata and stated that the book is preview/subscription content. ResearchGate explicitly reported no full text available for this conference paper. DBLP and other candidate pages exposed only bibliographic metadata or links back to the DOI. HAL exact searches and direct HAL/API fetch attempts did not produce a readable exact-work artifact in this environment. No readable PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements could be verified.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6649501.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
